voice_login.going_to_forgot_password: حسنًا، جارٍ نقلك إلى استعادة كلمة المرور.
voice_login.going_to_login: جارٍ نقلك إلى شاشة تسجيل الدخول.

voice_login.register_greeting: لنقم بتسجيلك. قل "التالي" للانتقال إلى الخطوة التالية، أو اطلب مني قراءة الخطوة الحالية.

voice_translator.intro: Have a live conversation across languages — each side speaks, the other hears it translated.
voice_translator.mic_error: تعذر الوصول إلى الميكروفون — تحقق من إذن الميكروفون وحاول مرة أخرى.
voice_translator.unsupported: Voice input not supported on this device
voice_translator.err_permission: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for MUSAFIR in your phone settings (Settings → Apps → MUSAFIR → Permissions → Microphone), then tap again.
voice_translator.err_no_mic: No working microphone was found. Check that nothing else is using it.
voice_translator.err_network: Speech recognition needs an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
voice_translator.err_no_speech: I didn't hear anything. Tap the button and speak clearly.
voice_translator.err_language: This language isn't supported for voice input on this phone. Pick another language, or install it in your phone's speech settings.
voice_translator.err_unavailable: Speech recognition isn't available on this phone. Install or enable Google's speech services and try again.
voice_translator.err_tts_language: Your phone has no voice for this language, so the translation can't be read aloud. You can still read it on screen — or install the voice in Settings → Language → Text-to-speech.
voice_translator.err_no_tts: This phone can't read text aloud. Read the translation on screen.
voice_translator.err_tts_failed: Couldn't play the translation aloud. Tap Play to retry.
voice_translator.same_language: Both sides are set to the same language -- pick different languages to translate.
voice_translator.permission_why: The translator listens through your microphone only while you tap the button, to turn your speech into text and translate it. Audio is handled by your phone's speech service.

womens_safety.escalated_notice: 🚨 This reads as urgent -- a real incident has been opened and sent to police, just like an SOS.
womens_safety.intro: Log how you're feeling about a situation -- we analyze it in real time and alert responders automatically if it reads as urgent.
womens_safety.saved_notice: Report saved. It's visible to you and, if needed, to the admin dashboard.
womens_safety.submit_failed: Couldn't submit your report right now.
womens_safety.textarea_placeholder: Describe what's happening, e.g. "I am alone and someone has been following me"

location.why: MUSAFIR needs your current location to measure real distances from where you are. It is used only while you use this feature.
location.denied: Location permission is off. Allow location for MUSAFIR in your phone settings (Settings → Apps → MUSAFIR → Permissions → Location), then try again.
location.unavailable: Your location couldn't be determined. Turn on GPS / Location services and make sure you have a signal, then try again.
location.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Move somewhere with a clearer sky or signal and try again.
location.unsupported: This device can't provide a location.

place_search.none: No matching place found -- try a more specific name (add the city).
place_search.failed: Couldn't search for places right now. Check your connection and try again.

trip.heading: Travel time & distance
trip.no_transit: Public-transport times need a Google Maps key on the server, so they are not shown.
trip.need_stop: Add at least one destination with a map location.
trip.need_location_or_two: Allow your location, or add at least two stops, to calculate travel time.
trip.failed: Couldn't calculate travel times right now. Check your connection and try again.
trip.arrive_first: If you leave now you reach {{name}} around {{time}}.
trip.estimate_note: Road routing was unavailable for some legs, so those are straight-line estimates — real travel will usually take longer.

explore.needs_location: Hidden spots, local food, the offline trip pack and festivals nearby all depend on where you are. Share your location to see them.
